purpose: Teach: 甚だ/へた/恐る恐る/とてつもない/なにかと/めずらしく/ほんのり/つき合い

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが甚だ無口でらした
lines.en: You know, Gran — when your father was young, he was such a quiet man.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into memory. Voice carries the weight of years. Warm but melancholic. Pauses slightly before details, as if turning pages in his mind. Gentle trailing-off.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、書道がお若い頃はへたでらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, yes — he was hopeless at calligraphy in those days, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: A small, knowing laugh threaded through. Affectionate teasing, the kind only a long marriage permits. Softly affirming, like she's completing his sentence. Warm, unhurried rhythm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと恐る恐る船旅に出たぞ
lines.en: When he was younger, Gran, I remember him taking me on a boat trip — nervous as anything, we were.
lines.style: The memory brightens slightly in his voice. A touch of gentle wonder at the specific moment. Still measured, but with a quiet gleam beneath. Slight emphasis on the shared fear.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、とてつもない大きな魚を釣られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He caught the most enormous fish that day, didn't he, dear? I'll never forget it.
lines.style: Delighted recollection. Her voice lifts a little — she knows this story, and she's proud of it. Rhythmic, conversational. A light touch of vindication in her tone, as if defending his competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、お父さんはなにかと家族を心配されたぞ
lines.en: He worried about us constantly, you know. Always something on his mind about the family.
lines.style: Reflective, almost tender concern in the words. No criticism — understanding, even. Voice settles lower, more intimate. A pause before 'constantly,' like he's still feeling that weight.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、めずらしく早起きされた朝もありましたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: But there were those rare mornings when he'd wake up early. Remember how he'd be up before anyone else?
lines.style: Bright recognition. Her voice carries the gentle surprise of rediscovering something small and precious. Conversational, drawing him in. A soft wonder at these exceptions to his usual pattern.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが、ほんのり頬を赤らめられたぞ
lines.en: I remember once — when he was still young — he got so flustered his whole face turned red.
lines.style: Tender amusement. Voice softens around the image of his younger self. Almost a whisper of affection. Deliberate pace, savoring the detail. A hint of smile in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ご近所とのつき合いを大事にされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He cared so much about keeping those neighborhood connections strong. He was really devoted to it, weren't you proud of him for that?
lines.style: Warm, affirming tone. She's validating something that mattered. Close to him now in her delivery — intimate without being loud. Gentle insistence on his virtue.
